question: Which of the following schemes was launched by the Chhattisgarh Government on the occasion of the International Day of Forests in 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mukhya Mantri Vriksha Sampada Yojana**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mukhya Mantri Vriksha Sampada Yojana** was launched by the Chhattisgarh Government on the occasion of the International Day of Forests in 2023.
 
• This scheme aims to promote afforestation and sustainable forest management in the state.
